# v0.9.0-preview

This preview is governed by the [Fabric Engineering OS Constitution](../../CONSTITUTION.md).

## Highlights

- Introduces eleven bounded agent roles and eight scenario-specific agent bundles.
- Adds a decision-oriented catalog for fourteen Microsoft Fabric capabilities.
- Publishes nine golden paths, twelve reusable patterns, and five reference architectures.
- Provides bootstrap guides for projects, features, data products, data agents, RTI, and mirroring.
- Establishes engineering standards, decision trees, community governance, and source-controlled wiki content.
- Adds GitHub issue and pull request templates, Copilot instructions, quality gates, and fail-closed DEV/TEST deployment adapters.
- Adds a protected PROD approval gate that records approval evidence but cannot deploy.

## Governance

Agents can prepare work and use approved DEV/TEST automation. Human owners remain accountable for architecture, pull request approval, merge, release, and production approval.

## Preview limitations

- Capability guidance must be checked against current Microsoft Learn documentation and target-tenant constraints.
- Deployment adapters intentionally fail closed until a generated project supplies reviewed, workload-specific implementation.
- Upstream architecture and implementation references are not vendored or synchronized.
- Preview document contracts may change before v1.0.0.

## Upgrade path

Repositories created from this preview should pin the template version they adopted, record local deviations, and review later releases through a normal human-approved pull request. The OS never updates downstream repositories automatically.
